native_cache_rebuild_verification: final source rebuilt and compared by SHA-256

portable_storage_tests.runtime: existing Linux VM, two CPUs and 1 GiB RAM

scope: Paired qualification of generic conditional-source changes; synthetic data, exact response equivalence, warm caches, no live model or independent native Linux host.
limits: Measurements are synthetic and host-dependent; medians are not universal speed or memory guarantees.
The constrained ARM64 Linux VM shares the same physical Mac; two CPUs and 1 GiB RAM.
CLI CPU/RSS excludes the Python fixture; request counts and transferred bytes are end-to-end fixture observations.

Tiny cold client CPU can increase despite fewer HTTP requests; warm and cold performance are reported separately. The final tiny mixed macOS comparison uses 15 alternating trials; other client cases use five.
Native process CPU includes background work; RSS is sampled every 5 ms, not an allocation bound.

Native caches are warm after ingestion; this does not qualify cold disk or remote object-store I/O. Native baseline is the recorded 9ca2 build; later PDF/inference/CI/README merges are included in the candidate, so measurements do not isolate every merge effect.
Repeated native reads are individually timed; response parsing/equivalence checks are outside elapsed timing.
Raw reports/logs remain local and unpublished under ignored output/.
native_materialization_policy: equal-mask read groups, at most 64 authorities; coalesced retained range bytes or full primary sizes admitted under 1 MiB per fresh scope, with one-large-row progress; singleton reads reuse their metadata scope

validation.persisted_certificate_upgrade: passed using the previous PR server and the new server on the same stored data
validation.window_metadata_calls: two sorted metadata batches per window; remaining reads grouped by exact mask and backend range capability, with 1 MiB admission, fresh per-chunk scopes, one-large-row progress and cancellation cleanup
validation.host_resource_note: An initial macOS suite run hit the unchanged watcher fallback assertion under concurrent fixture load; isolated rerun and the subsequent full suite both passed.
